description: Find users of an app by a partial email match (at least 3 characters, up to 20 results). Returns for each match its `_id`, email, language and stats, not the saved data or messages: neblla_get_user has the full record of one user. neblla_list_users pages through all users when no email is known.

emailPart.description: At least 3 characters of the email to match

env.description: Whose data: "pro" (the users', default) or "pre" (the app's pre, its own users and data unless it plays with pro's)

name: neblla_search_users_by_email
title: Search users by email
